name: Ferruginous-Hamada
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, a nearby asteroid belt emerge like the bones of the planet.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Instruments disagree about the exotic matter deposit: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Whoever solves this anomaly will rewrite several sciences. Whoever blunders into it will merely end several careers.
